facts.text: Gina mentioned that networking was a lifesaver for her business and helped her access products she might not have found otherwise.

evidence.quote: I had to do a lot of research and networking. My advice? Don't be scared to reach out to people in your field for help and contacts. Networking was a lifesaver for me and opened me up to amazing products that I might not have found otherwise.
